notes: Access: https://www.kapooreilluminations.com/ refuses connections directly on port 443 (WinError 10061 / curl 'connection refused' -- confirmed not a local-egress issue since a remote fetcher, r.jina.ai, hit the identical ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED). Port 80 is alive and issues a 301 (Location: http://kapoorlampshades.com) which itself 301s again to https://kapoorlampshades.com/ (cloudflare, 200). The rendered homepage title and the store's own Shopify shop object both read 'KAPOOR-E-ILLUMINATIONS PRIVATE LIMITED' with myshopifyDomain 'kapoorlamp-shades.myshopify.com' -- i.e. this is the SAME legal entity/storefront, rebranded from the 'Kapoor E-Illuminations' domain to the 'Kapoor Lamp Shades' domain/brand; it is not a duplicate company, it is the live current site for S.N. 309, reached via its own redirect. All extraction below was done on kapoorlampshades.com. Structure: extracted the real Shopify mega-menu tree (parsed <nav> markup by <ul> nesting depth, cross-checked against the flat link dump) -- 6 parent groups (Wall Lights, Pendant Lights, Lamps, Ceiling Lights, Lamp Shades, Lantern Lights) each with 'View all' -> the parent collection plus specific sub-collections, and 2 standalone top-level items (Chandeliers, Outdoor Lights). Counts: raw /collections.json 'products_count' field confirmed inflated vs reality (e.g. wall-scones raw=248 vs exhaustive=222; single-pendant-lights raw=122 vs 99; table-lamps raw=177 vs 153; ceiling-flush-lights raw=35 vs 26; chandeliers raw=83 vs 80) -- consistent with known Shopify unreliability, so every leaf qty instead used exhaustive dedup paging of /collections/<handle>/products.json (limit=250) AND was cross-verified against the collection page's own rendered 'N products' filter-panel header (BeautifulSoup text extraction) -- both methods matched exactly on all 18 leaves, strong confirmation. Excluded (non-navigable / not a product-type category, from the 31 total collections.json entries): best-selling, new-arrival, sale/Clearance Sale (promotional, NEVER EXTRACT), gift-card (not a product), frontpage (homepage alias), made-to-order (287 items -- cross-cutting attribute tag spanning many fixture types, a mixed roll-up, dropped not padded), luxury-lighting (64 items -- marketing roll-up spanning multiple types, dropped), functional-ceiling-lights (products_count=7 in collections.json but the collection's own products.json returns 0 live products and it has no nav link -- an empty/legacy collection, excluded). Cross-check: for each of the 6 parent collections, diffed its exhaustive product-handle set against the union of its child leaves' handle sets to look for missed sibling sub-types; Pendant Lights, Lamps, Lamp Shades, Ceiling Lights and Lantern Lights had zero or only-overlap leftovers (no missing branch), but Wall Lights parent (253 exhaustive) has 9 products not covered by any of its 3 listed children (Wall Sconces/Vanity Bathroom Mirror Wall Lights/Picture Wall Lights) -- spot-checked several (e.g. 'pimlico-metal-and-glass-wall-light', 'ortega-12-watt-outdoor-adjustable-wall-light-in-brass-finish') and they are genuine, in-scope wall-light fixtures simply left uncategorized by the merchant into any specific nav sub-type; not given a fabricated leaf row since the site itself exposes no dedicated URL/label for exactly that subset (only the full 253-item parent page, which would double-count the other 3 children) -- flagged here for transparency rather than padded or invented. Bulbs, fans and wiring (per company brief) were not present as separate collections; nothing needed excluding on that front. No Rule-0 room-word exclusions applied (Vanity/Bathroom Mirror Wall Lights kept in scope as a genuine wall-mirror-adjacent lighting fixture type). robots.txt on kapoorlampshades.com is a standard Shopify template (bots@shopify.com boilerplate, UCP/MCP notice) with no Claude-specific or catalogue-browse disallow.
